player_prompt.intro:
O cei Player {player_id}. O na vakatavulica na Memory Game.
O na noqu ilakolako me taura na pair vata kece na karta e na boro, me vaka na nomuni vakatawa.
Ena nomu turn, filamu na karta ruarua me wilika na nomu row kei column number na karta ko ya e vuqa na ya e rua respectively me vaka '[0 1 1 0]', me vaka na karta ya e vuqa e row 0 kei column 1, kei na karta ya e rua e row 1 kei column 0.
Ke taura na karta ruarua, o na taura na point kei na karta e taura tani. Ke sega ni taura, na karta e filamu tani ki na muri, me vaka '.'.
Na gemu e mava ena taura na pair kece na karta.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na ivakarau ni toso e sega ni dodonu. Sega ni sauma na dauqito {player_id} ena dua na idusidusi donu ena brackets veibasai.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Na misini e sega ni dodonu. na dauqito {player_id} digitaka e dua out-of-na iyalayala vanua.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Na dauqito {player_id} digitaka vakarua na kadi vata ga.
invalid_move.already_matched: Na misini e sega ni dodonu. na dauqito {player_id} digitaka dua se ruarua na kadi ka sa veisemati oti tu.

game_message.cards_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] match!
game_message.cards_no_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} do not match. Cards at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] are {pos1} and {pos2} respectively.

outcome.draw: Erau tautauvata na iwiliwili ni tikiniqele rau vakayagataka ruarua.
outcome.turn_limit: Na iyaloyalo ni turn e taura. Na gemu e mava. Player 0 e taura {score_0} point, Player 1 e taura {score_1} point.
